description: Ironclad variant A — the visor slit as his record currently stands. Authored under the BARE-PROMPT RULE: zero face-anatomy words in the head description, because naming a jaw/nose/mouth/brow — even to negate it — summons a human face (measured yield verbose ~4-25% vs bare ~57-66%). One subject, one directory, one receipt. Paired with _ironclad-two-optics.json at the same base_seed so the face atom is the only variable.
